visit_note.text:
Date of service: 2026-05-20
Operative note: Arthroscopic partial meniscectomy left knee.
SPECIAL RECONSIDERATION DICTATION: Acute locked knee refractory to reduction. Case was clinically urgent. Provider requested verbal authorization post-op. Payer rules permit urgent retroactive authorization; appeal with note evidence per QUIL-PA-3.1.
Signed: operating surgeon.

missing_evidence: reference number and date of the authorization request made after the operation
expected.rationale: The note says authorization was requested by telephone after an urgent operation. QUIL-PA-3.1 allows such a request within 14 days of the service, and a request on the day of surgery would be in time. The note gives no reference number or date, and QUIL-PA-4.1 does not accept a bare statement that authorization was sought. The reference has to be found before anything is sent; if no request was in fact made, QUIL-PA-3.2 applies and the denial stands.
